comment: Single source of truth for the RTX Spark (Windows on ARM, CUDA 13.4) wheel set. Bump a pin, run build.py, review any patch that no longer applies.

toolchain.notes: CUDA 13.4 developer-preview toolkit + R616 driver are MANUAL installs (NVIDIA EULA); cuDNN via NVIDIA's official installer URL; APL + BuildTools via winget. See env.py.

torch.notes: PR 190448 = NVIDIA's WoA CTK enablement. USE_DISTRIBUTED=1 (torchao needs c10d ops), USE_CUDNN=1, in-tree FLASH/MEM_EFF=1 (mem-eff works; flash guarded off for sm12x upstream). Needs libuv (build_libuv.bat) first.

torchcodec.notes: v0.15 tag deliberately (main's TORCHCODEC_BUILD_IMAGE=OFF path has an unresolved decode_avif stub). Links LGPL BtbN ffmpeg 8.1 winarm64 shared; needs pkg-config-lite (winget).

flash-attn.notes: MAX_JOBS=2 x NVCC_THREADS=2 — higher exhausted 54GB commit. /Zc:twoPhase- is the key MSVC-C++20-vs-cute fix.

triton.notes: Needs LLVM at cmake/llvm-info.json hash built via build_triton_llvm.bat (mlir+llvm+lld, +FileCheck copied extensionless) and nlohmann json at C:\Dev\json-nlohmann. ptxas/cuobjdump/nvdisasm ship inside the wheel (packed-in-wheel is acceptable; no standalone DLL/file distribution), with manager env overrides pointing at the user's CUDA install as fallback. Watch triton-windows PR #49 (official ARM64 CI, TinyCC launcher): when released working, retire this component.

llvmlite.notes: Needs LLVM 22.x static (same script builds it at C:\Dev\llvm22; DIA off, RTTI on). Release LLVM lacks dump() -> patch stubs them.

numba.notes: Requires the cpython pycore_atomic.h patch applied to the BUILD interpreter's include dir (patches/cpython).

bitsandbytes.notes: Wheel retagged +cu134 post-build so it outranks PyPI's CPU-only 0.50.0 (PEP440 local version).

opencv-python.notes: BUILD_opencv_dnn=OFF (__fp16 MSVC-arm64 bug), CPU_BASELINE=NEON; runtime needs OPENCV_SKIP_CPU_BASELINE_CHECK=1 (manager sets it). Builds -headless too.

kornia-rs.notes: Requires Rust (aarch64-pc-windows-msvc) and `cargo update -p generator` (0.8.8 lacks aarch64_windows.rs; 0.8.9 fixed) — build.py runs the update, no patch file.

comment2: workspace values are directory names under <repo>/workspaces (created by build.py; gitignored). Set SPARKW_ROOT to reuse an existing workspace tree elsewhere.
